title: MCP wire head doesn't plumb project context to surface evaluation
wanted_capability: Project-scoped surface routing packets reachable through the wire MCP head (?surface=...), not only through the dispatch path
notes: Linked to the project-taxonomy-standardization arc (taxonomy/resolver-consolidation branch): resolve_project_context + ProjectContext (slice 1) and alias resolution (slice 2) give the wire head a single resolver to plumb ?project=/surface params through. Pull this in as a consumer after slice 3 (adapter migration) — the wire head becomes one more resolve_project_context(Read) call site rather than its own scoping mechanism.
resolution_note: Shipped on taxonomy/resolver-consolidation: the wire MCP head now extracts ?project= alongside ?surface= at initialize, resolves it through resolve_project_context(Read) (accepts alias / project_id / any path inside a registered checkout or worktree → base canonical path; literal fallback for parity with bbox_mcp_surface), pins it to the session, and passes it through every surface lookup (get_tool/list_tools/call_tool). The SurfaceDecisionCache already keyed (surface, project) — only the wire extraction was missing. Project-scoped surface routing packets are now reachable through ?surface=...&project=... on the wire head, not only the dispatch path.
